name: Unphased increases spell penetration and reduces pushback while Inner Demon is active (#919)
contract: Unphased 803645: "Increases your spell penetration by 20, scaling with your level. In addition, reduces spell pushback suffered from damaging attacks by 50% while Inner Demon is active." Effect 0 (aura 123, SPELL_AURA_MOD_TARGET_RESISTANCE, misc 124) is unconditional and level-scaled (base -21, RealPointsPerLevel -1.0, BaseLevel/SpellLevel 20); at level 80 it computes to -80 regardless of Inner Demon. Effect 1 as authored is aura 107 (ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, SPELLMOD_EFFECT1) selecting Inner Demon 804216's own effect 0 (aura 36, MOD_SHAPESHIFT) - a value nothing reads, so the pushback half was inert. It is retargeted to aura 149 (SPELL_AURA_REDUCE_PUSHBACK, base 49 + 1 = 50, no level scaling) and gated to zero while Inner Demon (804216) is inactive by felsworn_scaling::ModifySpellEffectBaseValue, recalculated whenever Inner Demon is applied or removed by aura_ascension_felsworn_lifecycle. The core reads SPELL_AURA_REDUCE_PUSHBACK in Spell::Delayed/Spell::DelayedChannel; this harness has no cast-delay metric, so the pushback half is proven via the raw aura_amount effect 1 toggling 0/50 with Inner Demon, not via an observed delay reduction.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Spell penetration is already active before Inner Demon (level-scaled, unconditional)
Pushback reduction is inert before Inner Demon
Spell penetration is unaffected by entering Inner Demon
Pushback reduction activates at 50% while Inner Demon is active
Pushback reduction drops back to inert once Inner Demon ends
Spell penetration still works after Inner Demon ends
